title: Grateful Dead Live at Theatre Hall on 1972-05-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures a smoking‑hot May 16 1972 Luxembourg show, featuring the solid 1972 setlist and standout Pigpen performances.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its nice mix and clear soundboard quality, delivering an energetic, in‑the‑pocket performance of the classic ’72 setlist. Pigpen’s three numbers – especially his “It Hurts Me Too” – are highlighted as exceptional, and listeners describe the overall show as a “smoking hot” experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and emphasized both strong musical performance and good recording quality, though only two reviews provide detailed comments about the music.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a nice mix and clear sound; no specific issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid 1972 setlist performed in the pocket with high energy throughout.
